verses.t: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
Be still, and know that I am God.
This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
A friend loveth at all times.
Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid.
Fear thou not; for I am with thee.
For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
I am the bread of life.
I am the light of the world.
I am the good shepherd.
I am the way, the truth, and the life.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son.
Love one another; as I have loved you.
Peace, be still.
Suffer the little children to come unto me.
Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works.
Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find.
And, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world.
It is more blessed to give than to receive.
I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another.
Pray without ceasing.
God is love.
We love him, because he first loved us.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord.
Give, and it shall be given unto you.
He is not here: for he is risen, as he said.
Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
Honour thy father and thy mother.

saints.name: Saint Nicholas
saints.symbols: 📖 Gospel book · ✝ bishop's cross-covered stole · 🎁 secret gifts
saints.about: Bishop of Myra, famous for his kindness and secret gifts. Feast: 6 December.

saints.name: Saint George
saints.about: Great Martyr and soldier who stayed faithful to Christ. The dragon shows good defeating evil.

saints.name: Saint Demetrios
saints.about: Great Martyr and soldier, patron of Thessalonica.

saints.name: Saint Panteleimon
saints.symbols: 🧰 medicine box · 🥄 small spoon · 🧑 young doctor
saints.about: Healer who treated the sick for free. His name means “all-merciful”.

saints.name: Saint John the Baptist
saints.symbols: 👼 wings · 📜 scroll · 🪓 axe at the root of a tree
saints.about: The Forerunner, shown with wings as God's messenger.

saints.name: Saint Peter
saints.symbols: 🗝 keys · 📜 scroll · 🧔 short grey curly beard
saints.about: Leader among the apostles, a fisherman called by Jesus.

saints.name: Saint Paul
saints.symbols: ⚔ sword · 📚 book of letters · 🧑‍🦲 high forehead
saints.about: Apostle to the nations, who wrote many letters.

saints.name: Saint Luke
saints.symbols: 🎨 icon of the Theotokos · 🐂 ox · 🩺 physician
saints.about: Evangelist and physician; tradition says he painted the first icon of the Mother of God.

saints.name: Saint Mark
saints.about: Evangelist, whose Gospel begins with a voice crying in the wilderness.

saints.name: Saint Matthew
saints.about: Evangelist and former tax collector.

saints.name: Saint John the Theologian
saints.symbols: 🦅 eagle · 📖 “In the beginning was the Word”
saints.about: The beloved disciple, who soared like an eagle in writing about God.

saints.name: Saint Katherine
saints.about: Wise Great Martyr of Alexandria.

saints.name: Saint Barbara
saints.about: Great Martyr, whose tower's three windows honoured the Holy Trinity.

saints.name: Saint Elijah
saints.about: Prophet taken up to heaven in a chariot of fire.

saints.name: Saint Moses
saints.about: Prophet who received the Ten Commandments.

saints.name: Archangel Michael
saints.about: Leader of the heavenly army.

saints.name: Archangel Gabriel
saints.about: Brought the good news of the Annunciation.

saints.name: Saint Spyridon
saints.about: Shepherd bishop of Cyprus, whose relics rest on Corfu.

saints.name: Saint Seraphim of Sarov
saints.about: Russian monk full of joy, who greeted all: “My joy, Christ is risen!”

saints.name: Saint Helen
saints.about: Mother of Saint Constantine; she found the Holy Cross.
